free_text_notes.physician_note: 74-year-old woman with prior TIA, hyperlipidemia, admitted 6/8 with right pontine lacunar infarct. NIHSS improved from 6 to 2. The patient receives home care visits twice a week for personal care. This existing service was confirmed as still in place and the home-care provider has been notified of the discharge date.
